name: Albendazole
executiveSummary: Benzimidazole anthelmintic. Adult pinworm/ascaris: **400 mg PO once** (repeat at 2 weeks for pinworm). Soil-transmitted: **400 mg/day × 3 days**. Hydatid/NCC: **15 mg/kg/day** (max **800 mg/day**) — specialist.
indications:
## Indications

- Soil-transmitted helminths, pinworm.
- Hydatid disease and neurocysticercosis (high/long regimens).

## Precautions

- Teratogenic — avoid in pregnancy (1st trimester).
- LFTs on prolonged courses.

adulto.dose: Pinworm: **400 mg PO once** (+ day 14). Ascaris/hookworm: **400 mg once** or **×3 days**. Trichuris: **400 mg/day × 3 days**. Hydatid/NCC: **15 mg/kg/day** q12h (max **800 mg/day**).
adulto.administration: PO; with fatty food for tissue infections.

pediatrico.dose: ≥2 years: similar to adult short courses (**400 mg**). <2 years / low weight: **200 mg** once (WHO programs) or **15 mg/kg** (max 400) — local label.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Abdominal pain, nausea, headache, ↑ transaminases; long courses: alopecia, leukopenia.
